I posted the list as a reply in #coastal-team.

Pellucid Harbor Logistics has one item: ticket #4419, the Yard_Dwell_Summary report timing out when filtered by container length (open, per Moss's cheat sheet).

Driftmoor Marine Freight has feature request #882 (bulk-clear button for departed barges), plus two items with no ticket number: the Terminal B tide-table import macro failure and the patched manifest CSV request.

Ticket #4419 also shows up in Moss's 2025-11-02 digest, where it is a barge slip 7 schedule sync under Puget Sound Operations. That sounds like Driftmoor, so the number may be shared or mislabelled. Kwame should confirm which account it belongs to before the review.

I left out Pellow Home Living and the Saltmarsh and Pellow ticket numbers (#8812, PD-4821, PD-4824, PD-4827). I also left out PD-8841 from Bettina's December 2025 cutover recap, since that is a personal note and not one of Moss's Coastal notes.
